_comment: Shared fixture for the placeholder-encoding contract.
The exporter (Python) and the deployer (Terraform) each derive placeholder
keys independently from a resource NAME. They never talk to each other, so
they agree only because both apply the same transform. If either side drifts,
every placeholder silently fails to resolve and templatefile() errors at
apply time in whichever environment applies first.
Both tests/test_encoding.py and tests/encoding.tftest.hcl read THIS file, so
neither implementation can be changed without the other failing.
reference_substitutor.py and the replace() chain in modules/flow-deployer.
